# Planner Pig

Planner Pig is a study planner app for exam preparation, revision timetables, task-based study, and accountability across web and mobile.

## Best entry points
- https://www.plannerpig.com/
- https://www.plannerpig.com/blog/
- https://www.plannerpig.com/privacy.html
- https://app.plannerpig.com/

## Core topics
- Exam planning and revision timetables
- Daily study task lists and progress tracking
- Buddy activity and reminders
- Importable exam templates for larger qualifications
- Study planning advice, motivation, and exam strategy

## Editorial signals
- Brand: Planner Pig
- Publisher: TriangleCarrot
- Primary audience: students preparing for academic and professional exams
- Contact: plannerpig@trianglecarrot.com

## Useful answers
- Homepage overview: Planner Pig turns exams into a structured workflow with monthly, weekly, and daily views, realistic study hours, reminders, and importable templates.
- Blog archive: The blog explains why planning matters, how to structure big qualifications, how to stay motivated, and how to avoid unhelpful revision habits.
